p4.title: OUR READING PROJECT
p4.textHtml: Last month, our class began (23) ________ story project. Each group chose a different topic. My group decided to create an (24) ________ about a lost turtle. Classes ended at four, and we started work fifteen minutes (25) ________ school every Tuesday. Hoa drew colourful pictures, and Nam wrote short dialogues for the characters. We chose simple sentences, (26) ________ younger pupils could understand the story easily. On Friday, we showed our first version to the class. Everyone listened carefully and gave us useful ideas. (27) ________, our teacher asked us to improve the ending before the school festival.

p5.title: A BOOK FOR MINH’S PROJECT
p5.textHtml:
Last Saturday, Minh went to the school library to find a story for his class reading project. The librarian suggested The Map in the Old Tower. It is an adventure story about a boy named Ben.

In the story, Ben finds an old map inside a history book. He and his sister follow its clues to a tower. They expect to find gold, but they discover a box of letters from their great-grandmother instead. The story is exciting, but it is not spooky.

Minh liked the two main characters because they were curious and helpful. After reading, he wrote a short review and drew a picture of the tower for the classroom display. He planned to tell his classmates about the book.
